title: campanula rotundifolia subsp. ruscinonensis
intro: Campanula rotundifolia subsp. ruscinonensis, commonly known as Hairy Bellflower or Ruscin Harebell, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Campanulaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Campanula rotundifolia subsp. ruscinonensis are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
